message.ru: Проверьте OCR, соответствие позиций подгруппам и подписи к изображениям. Отсутствующие коды не восстановлены.
message.en: Review OCR, subgroup assignments and image captions. Missing codes were not reconstructed.

resolution.ru: Разметка, изображения и подписи сверены с исходными страницами.
resolution.en: Layout, images and captions compared with the source pages.

review.importMethod: 600-DPI Tesseract PSM3/11 plus isolated PSM7/13 at multiple scales; independent Codex visual readings; additional local Apple Vision OCR; official CONMED catalog cross-check. No prefix or ambiguous-character substitutions.

codeVerification.policy: A source code is accepted only when independent visual reading agrees exactly with at least one raw OCR reading. Official matches corroborate; no T-prefix or case/suffix corrections are inferred.

review.publicationReason: Explicit owner authorization: automatically publish imported systems with zero real flags.
